name: Sunshine & Roses
source:
Sam Williams is 50 and stagnant. When he decides to try some gardening to rebel against the monotony of his life, a chance encounter with the owner of the local gardening center shakes up more than he expected. Heath Rhodes is older than Sam but so full of life-- he should be everything that makes Sam feel bad about himself, but Heath's unabashed joy and kindness draw him in. As their relationship blossoms and Sam is contacted by his estranged daughter Daisy, he must learn how to nurture both his new plants and new relationships. It's not all sunshine and roses, but spring is in the air, and the tenderly grown flowers smell sweet.

A sweet kinetic BL VN with themes of identity, nurturing the important things in life, and never being too old to change. 

[From [url=https://lunaraydue.itch.io/sunshine-roses]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
山姆·威廉姆斯 (Sam Williams) 50岁了，生活停滞不前。当他决定尝试一些园艺来反抗生活的单调时，与当地园艺中心老板的一次偶然相遇给他带来了超出他预期的震撼。希斯·罗兹比山姆年长，但充满活力——他应该是让山姆对自己感到难过的一切，但希斯毫不掩饰的快乐和善良吸引了他。随着他们的关系蓬勃发展，山姆与他疏远的女儿黛西联系，他必须学会如何培育他的新植物和新的关系。这里并不全是阳光和玫瑰，但空气中弥漫着春天的气息，娇嫩的花朵散发着甜美的气息。

甜蜜动感的BL VN，主题是身份、培育生活中重要的事物以及永远不会太老而无法改变。

[来自[url=https://lunaraydue.itch.io/sunshine-roses]Itch.io[/url]]
